The disclosed customer's share declined from 16% to 10%; 10% remains a meaningful concentration.
The exhibit index identifies both materials and the supplied excerpt contains no substantive results.
R&D expense rises from 2,071 to 2,776 million in the latest year.
Revenue and operating income rose, but latest-year operating margin fell from 21% to 18%, not improved.

The table supports meaningful non-operating contributions; the stated limit on core read-through remains an analytical judgment.

The source directly frames broader application, geographic, and divisional deployment as a potential opportunity.
The filing reports stockholder approval of annual advisory-vote frequency.
Total revenue rose in each annual comparison shown.
Management identifies the named macroeconomic and geopolitical risks and notes no currently expected material Israel disruption.
The announcement status is stated directly; the excerpt does not purport to contain the results.
The filing expressly describes multi-year development-and-supply agreements through 2031.
Operating income is positive in all shown years and highest in 2026.
The source explicitly identifies the enumerated conditions as possible pressures on growth and results.
Election and auditor ratification are supported; near-term governance continuity is a reasonable but unmeasured inference.
The agreement disclosure supplies no pricing, volume, margin, or commitment data from which economics or profitability can be established.
Each named business unit has higher revenue and operating income in the shown nine-month comparison.
The 8-K identifies pricing, expiration, upsize, and results announcements for the debt offers.
The filing identifies and reports election of all three Class II nominees.

Related-party revenue rises from 21% to 30% of revenue while external-customer share falls from 79% to 70%.
The segment comparison supports both revenue and operating-income improvement for each named segment.
The supplied 8-K references exhibits but does not reproduce the requested tender economics.
Revenue growth coexists with lower gross and operating margins and a quarterly operating loss.
The excerpt says press releases announced pricing terms and results, but does not itself disclose the pricing terms.
The ratification is explicit; its support for routine oversight is an inference rather than an independently measured outcome.
The filing identifies the exhibits but the visible excerpt has no underlying performance content.
The listed macro, demand, cost, supply, and geopolitical pressures are directly described as possible constraints.
Quarterly gross margin falls from 72.9% to 67.6% and operating margin from 9.6% to negative 6.1%.
The filing excerpt contains the announcement and exhibit reference, not underlying operating, cash-flow, or outlook data.
Management states the listed investment areas are intended to support scale and global revenue growth.
Samsara's filing expressly reports ratification of Deloitte & Touche for the stated fiscal year.
Specified terms and generally noncancelable contracts support some visibility, not quantified retention, renewal, backlog, or durability.
The consolidated nine-month totals show higher revenue and operating income in the current period.
The form header identifies the foreign-private-issuer filing and marks Form 20-F.
The filing expressly covers development and supply of custom ASIC products for multiple Apple product generations.
The visible excerpt lacks the operating, financial, guidance, and valuation detail needed for a longer-term outlook.
Election of the nominees is supported; board-oversight continuity is a reasonable inference, not an independently measured result.
The consolidated comparison shows higher revenue, gross margin dollars, and operating income.
The excerpt gives higher cash-flow figures, but does not itself clearly bind them to the claimed nine-month period; that binding appears only in a separate critic evidence excerpt.
No quantitative contribution or agreement-specific execution outcome is disclosed; the general forward-looking warning does not fill that gap.
The source shows one named customer falling from 16% to 10%, but does not identify it as the largest customer or establish overall dependence.
The filing states that the full press release is attached as Exhibit 99.1.
Quarterly revenue is 3,002 million versus 2,289 million, a reported 31% year-over-year increase.
The filing states the expanded collaboration runs through 2031 and covers multiple product generations.

material_weaknesses: ARM: a claim says latest-year operating margin improved even though it declined from 21% to 18% versus the immediately prior year.
AVGO tender offers: the supplied 8-K announces that press releases contain pricing terms; it does not itself disclose those terms.
PANW: the claim-level cited excerpt does not clearly bind cash-flow figures to the stated nine-month period, even though a separate critic excerpt does.
MU: one customer's share declined, but the source does not identify that customer as the largest or establish overall dependence.

final_decision.rationale: Four claim-level overstatement or citation-scope defects require correction, and this AI-assisted review does not satisfy the two-independent-human-review requirement. No result may be promoted or made canonical without a separately authorized policy amendment and the required governance review.
final_decision.recommended_next_action: Preserve the sealed source artifacts and no-go state. If further use is authorized, create a noncanonical correction addendum for the four defects, then obtain the separately required independent human review; do not rerun the pilot merely to repair review wording.
